auth.identificador_ayuda: The one on your badge. A company email also works if you have one.

activar.primera_vez: First time here? Activate your account
activar.subtitulo: Confirm who you are and create your password. No one else will know it, not even IT.
activar.donde_codigo: IT hands it to you. It works only once.
activar.ya_tengo_cuenta: I already have an account, sign me in
activar.error: The account could not be activated.
activar.fecha_ingreso: Your start date at the company
activar.donde_fecha: The one on your contract. It is what proves it is you.

dashboard.title: IT Support Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Tracking and resolution management for technical incidents
dashboard.search_placeholder: Search by ticket folio or description...

ticket.solucion_placeholder: Explain what was done to resolve the issue. This text feeds the knowledge base.
ticket.solucion_ok: The solution is detailed enough to document the closure.
ticket.cerrar_ayuda: A ticket cannot be closed without explaining how it was resolved. The solution stays in the history and feeds the search for similar incidents.
ticket.error_cierre: The ticket could not be closed. Review the solution and try again.
ticket.pendiente_indexar: Pending indexing into the knowledge base.

adjuntos.arrastra: Drag a photo here or click to choose
adjuntos.formatos: Images, PDF or text · up to 10 MB each
adjuntos.confirmar_borrar: Remove this file from the ticket?
adjuntos.error_subir: The file could not be uploaded.
adjuntos.error_borrar: The file could not be removed.
adjuntos.error_abrir: The file could not be opened.

horario.fuera_de_horario: The IT team is not available right now.
horario.mientras_tanto: You can still open your ticket: it will be logged and picked up as soon as they are in. Meanwhile the assistant will show more solutions than usual, in case you can fix it yourself.

new_ticket.title: Report an IT Incident
new_ticket.checklist_notice: Please complete this quick self-service check before opening a ticket.
new_ticket.question_resolved: Did these steps resolve your issue?
new_ticket.yes_resolved: Yes, issue is resolved (Do not open ticket)
new_ticket.no_continue: No, I still need IT assistance
new_ticket.ticket_resolved_checklist: Great! Your issue was resolved using the troubleshooting guide.
new_ticket.resuelto_por_checklist: Resolved by the user with the checklist:

kb.resuelto_titulo: Done! Your issue was solved by a previous case.
kb.resuelto_detalle: No need to open a ticket. If the problem comes back, you can still raise one.

chat.bienvenida: Tell me what is going on and I will point you to the right place. You can also use the regular form if you prefer.
chat.clasificado: This looks like a {{categoria}} issue. Opening the form for you.
chat.pedir_categoria: To help you better, is this about...?
chat.escalando: Let us hand this to the IT team. Opening the form with what you wrote.

metricas.title: Portal Metrics
metricas.subtitle: Last {{dias}} days · Querétaro Plant
metricas.deflexion_ayuda: Incidents resolved without IT stepping in.
metricas.tiempo_ayuda: Only tickets handled by a technician.
metricas.normalizados_ayuda: Share of tickets Ollama managed to rewrite.
metricas.utilidad_ayuda: Suggestions marked useful out of those shown. This is what calibrates the threshold.
metricas.umbral_ayuda: Too low suggests noise; too high almost never suggests.
metricas.pendientes_ayuda: Closed with a solution Ollama has not processed yet. reindexar_kb.py picks them up.
metricas.precision_ayuda: Detected category vs. the final one. Over {{n}} comparable cases.
metricas.ollama_caido: Ollama is not responding. The portal works the same, just without AI assistance.
metricas.latencia_nota: Latencies are for this process since last restart, not a historical series.

temas.title: Topics & Knowledge
temas.subtitle: Diagnostic steps, saved solutions, and new problems the portal detected.
temas.sin_pasos: No steps in this category yet.
temas.pregunta_ejemplo: e.g. Is the video cable firmly seated at both ends?
temas.accion: What to do / what to check
temas.accion_ejemplo: e.g. Unplug it and plug it back in firmly at both ends.
temas.marca_resuelve: If they answer yes, the issue is resolved and no ticket is created
temas.confirmar_baja: Retire this step? It stops showing but keeps its history.
temas.error_cargar: The information could not be loaded.
temas.error_guardar: Could not save. Check the fields and try again.
temas.sin_kb: The knowledge base is empty. It fills itself as tickets are closed with a solution.
temas.titulo_ejemplo: e.g. Monitor with no image or "no signal"
temas.solucion_ejemplo: Describe what to check and in what order, as you would explain it to someone on the floor.
temas.nota_vector: On save it is indexed for similarity search. If Ollama is down, it stays pending.
temas.confirmar_borrar_kb: Delete this solution from the knowledge base?
temas.sin_detectados_detalle: When someone reports something that does not fit the categories, the portal groups it here. If the same problem repeats, it appears ready to become a topic.
temas.en_que_categoria: Which category does it belong to?
temas.prellenado_historial: Pre-filled with a previous ticket solution. Edit as you like.

usuarios.title: People
usuarios.subtitle: Who has access, in what state, and what they are accountable for.
usuarios.nota_flujo: Creating the account generates a single-use code. Hand it to the person: they use it to set their own password, which IT never knows. If you also fill in the start date, they can activate with that instead of the code.
usuarios.buscar: Search by name, email or department...
usuarios.confirmar_restablecer: Reset the password for {{nombre}}? Their current password will stop working and they will create a new one with the code generated.
usuarios.codigo_unica_vez: This code is shown only once.
usuarios.error_alta: The person could not be added.
usuarios.error_accion: The operation could not be completed.
usuarios.error_documento: The document could not be generated.
usuarios.numero_empleado_ayuda: This is how they sign in. It must match the badge.
usuarios.fecha_ingreso_ayuda: Lets the account be activated without a code, by checking the date.
usuarios.numero_provisional: Placeholder number · set the real one

docti.title: IT Documentation
docti.subtitle: Procedures, addressing, vendors. What today lives in two people’s heads.
docti.buscar_significado: Describe what you need, even if you forgot the title...
docti.por_significado: Search by meaning, not just words
docti.titulo_ejemplo: e.g. How to set up a user in the phone system
docti.contenido_ejemplo: Write the steps, the addresses, the contacts... what would be needed if you were not here tomorrow.
docti.marcar_sensible: Mark as sensitive (not for reading over someone’s shoulder)
docti.vacio: No documentation yet. Start with whatever you get asked most.

impresora.encendida: Is the printer turned on and securely plugged into power?
impresora.papel_toner: Does it have sufficient paper/labels and installed ribbon/toner?
impresora.reinicio: Did you try turning off the printer for 10 seconds and back on?

red.cable: Is the ethernet cable firmly connected to both wall and computer?
red.wifi: Is the plant Wi-Fi network active on your device?

importar.title: Import staff
importar.subtitle: Register the whole plant from one file instead of one person at a time.
importar.elegir: Drop the CSV file here, or click to choose it
importar.columnas_minimas: Bare minimum: employee number and name. Email and start date are optional.
importar.filas_con_problema: Rows that will not be imported
importar.nota_errores: Rows with problems are skipped; the rest are imported.
importar.como_activan: How will people sign in the first time?
importar.modo_codigo_detalle: A single-use code for each person. They have to be handed out.
importar.modo_verificacion: With their number and start date
importar.modo_verificacion_detalle: Nothing to hand out: each person identifies with data they already know.
importar.faltan_fechas: {{n}} start date(s) are missing. In this mode the whole file is rejected.
importar.codigos_unica_vez: Codes are shown only once. If you close this screen without downloading them, they must be regenerated one by one.
importar.sin_codigos_titulo: There are no codes to hand out.
importar.sin_codigos_detalle: Each person signs in with their employee number and start date.
importar.error_analizar: The file could not be read.
importar.error_importar: The import could not be completed.
